how: Calls recruit participants for starting, defending, and extending the shared work.
A bare written acceptance answers the opening proposal without asking for a return.
A member reports already starting a cursor, instantiating a local starter without identifying one founder of the whole project.
Members propose Windows details and redesign neighbouring artwork as parts of the expanding taskbar.
Members report a pixel repaired and a cursor already begun.
Templates, font specifications, and pixel corrections give participants common placement instructions.
Scripts extend the taskbar and provoke conflicting reports about their effects on other work.
Posting a template settles execution only when revisions reach participants and automated targets, since stale versions can overwrite newly negotiated designs.
Instructions require continuing synchronization between negotiated changes, published templates, and the designs participants actually follow.
Automation also answers anticipated absence, expansion, and a working clock, so strain from defensive upkeep is only one possible antecedent.

statement: Routing proposals through an external decision venue
how: Participants use an external chat for coordination and send incorporation proposals to its administrators.

statement: Maintaining access to the coordinating venue
how: Expired invitations and requests to join make venue access a practical condition of participation rather than an automatic consequence of referral.

statement: Using the mark to recruit its next builders
how: Building a button naming the room is explicitly prioritized to attract manpower for further work, although the resulting recruitment effect remains unverified.
One room cannot test the comparative frequency claim, and a poll or moderator appointment does not establish binding authority over placement.
Repeated alarms mobilize defence of the taskbar and incorporated artworks.
Keeping placed work does not necessarily put upkeep before growth, because participants explicitly recruit defenders and expanders at the same time.
Participants diagnose friendly interference by blaming scripts and stale targets, while another speaker disputes the damage report.
Preservation pleas, promises to spare work, and an apology for overwriting make restraint visible without establishing universal compliance.
Participants announce borders, invoke earlier agreements, and change a title design to accommodate a negotiated compromise.
Help is offered in exchange for keeping neighbouring work, and a compromise receives a direct promise of defence.
A participant consults their home subreddit while negotiating in the host chat, demonstrating message carriage without proving authority to bind the group.
An existing bilateral alliance is invoked for defence, while a separate coalition invitation establishes solicitation rather than confirmed membership.
Guests seek host approval and space while hosts prioritize places for groups whose artwork their expansion displaced.
Accommodation can preserve a group's representation by moving or remaking its artwork as a window or icon rather than leaving the original work intact.
Hosts ration accommodation by reserving places for displaced groups, making compensatory priority part of admission rather than a simple grant of unused space.
Neighbour negotiation can arise from the room's expanding design threatening existing art rather than only from defending an established mark against erosion.
A settled border restrains willing participants only, because a member can explicitly reject a treaty in favour of completing the design.
Restraint also requires updated automated targets, because stale scripts can overwrite the work protected by a new agreement.
A member explicitly refuses an announced treaty, demonstrating that agreement in the room's name does not guarantee individual compliance.
An announced boundary receives a direct refusal from a participant who prioritizes a complete design over the treaty.
A blue-background compromise receives a direct acceptance and offer to defend the tray.
A maintenance request receives a written promise of outside defence, but the cited exchange does not establish a preceding shortage under attack as its cause.
A guest's relocation and later successor-canvas invitations do not establish the focal room moving its own erased work after weighing fighting against retreat.
Requests for defenders and expanders show labour sought without establishing a collective judgment that the room has too few hands to hold its spot.
The cited move concerns a guest making space for the taskbar, not the focal room abandoning its own spot after judging its strength inadequate.
Windows jokes show an idiom used during the event but do not establish that the room carried a shared identity or routine into it beforehand.

statement: Using the shared design as a practical and playful idiom
how: The design supplies language for jokes, attack descriptions, and operational additions without requiring evidence of a pre-existing collective identity.
Expansion rhetoric invokes historical language without demonstrating that the room brought a pre-canvas quarrel into the event.
An individual's political alteration proposal does not establish a pre-existing room tie that names its collective rival.
A moderator concentrates deals and offers into a megathread and chat, supporting functional routing without establishing displacement of ordinary subreddit activity.
Centralizing diplomacy establishes a routing decision but does not establish a prior flood of canvas calls overwhelming ordinary host discussion.
A Windows joke does not establish a host-wide April Fools takeover or fake-news frame.
Members celebrate completion, thank collaborators, and praise the preservation of another group's penguin.
Participants mark the event's ending and separately request a time-lapse record.
Post-event preparation of a repaired final image supports participation in cleanup, while no quoted concept establishes a dispute about preserving damage as history.
Participants propose several successor canvases and report one Windows bar begun but still incomplete.
Continuation invitations name a purpose to continue but do not establish preserving an image or record as the cause of moving to another canvas.
An official continuation announcement must be distinguished from accepted venue authority and completed rebuilding when several destinations remain in circulation.
An explicit destruction call and acknowledged overwriting establish attack and encroachment without treating every design addition as hostile.
Resistance recruitment, threats of vandalism, and victory claims carry the canvas contest into talk.
A destruction call directly receives a refusal justified by the shared task of creating rather than destroying.
A bare acceptance and reports of work support participation but do not establish the wider mechanism that recruitment brought the reported builders onto the canvas.
A local starter reports beginning work, but the retained concept does not establish others subsequently gathering calls around that starter.
A finished-button discussion reports immediate pixel repair, supporting the overlap between completion and the need to keep placed work intact.
Completion celebrations and repair reports co-occur without a retained passage establishing the reported state as the cause of collective marking.
Celebration, a time-lapse request, and final-image repair occur without a retained passage establishing celebration as the cause of recording.
One bare acceptance supports the response form but cannot test the theorised preference mechanism or the comparative distribution of acceptances and refusals.
Recruitment and a destruction call are both observed, but no retained quotation shows recruited helpers being redirected into that attack.
Integration follows acknowledged damage, but the coded record does not supply a direct attack-call response invoking a truce or proposing a deal.
Attack calls and victory taunts are observed without a retained link establishing that the former caused the latter.
A defence call invokes an alliance, but a separate coalition invitation does not establish joining because of an attack or shortage.
Incorporation is followed by an explicit maintenance request and a written offer of outside defence, connecting accommodation to further labour without proving a universal recruitment effect.
Restraint must be attributed to particular pleas, promises, and apologies rather than inferred as a uniform room decision from their coexistence with expansion.
